blocks.text: Labwc is the Wayland compositor. Right-click an empty part of the desktop for its menu. Drag a titlebar to move a window and use the titlebar controls to minimize, maximize or close it. Alt+Tab cycles the current workspace; Waybar workspace buttons change workspace.

The primary files are ~/.config/labwc/rc.xml, menu.xml and environment. The managed session also uses labwc-session.target and user services. Prefer the existing graphical settings and refresh actions; changing environment normally requires signing out and back in.
If one application fails, close and reopen that application before restarting desktop components. Use [Logs](help:maintenance.logs) to inspect the owning user unit. Save your work before signing out.
The existing private Xwayland path is restricted to Zoom and Discord. Do not enable session-wide Xwayland or route other applications through those compatibility helpers.
